02
Antique & Home Décor Brand
A/B Audience Test: 133 WhatsApp Conversations
Objective
Identify the most cost-effective audience strategy for driving WhatsApp conversations with real buyers, before committing to a larger ad spend for an antique and home décor brand.
My Role
Designed a controlled A/B audience experiment. Ad Set 1 used narrow interest-based targeting (décor enthusiasts), Ad Set 2 went broad letting Meta's algorithm find buyers freely. Monitored both over 4 days and analyzed results to determine the best scaling strategy.
Results
133
Messages
PKR 13
Narrow CPL
PKR 15
Broad CPL
11,978
Impressions
Narrow targeting won at PKR 13 vs PKR 15 per message. The experiment gave the brand clear, data-backed direction for scaling confidently.
